_about: Pacing targets. 'rules' are Kristian's five pacing rules (2026-11-12) as pass/fail checks, judged on the Cautious bot unless 'bot' says otherwise ('all' = every bot). 'targets' are milestone day ranges for the Cautious bot's median run (early / on target / late). The first opening is day 11 (shop.setupDays 10).

rules.label: From Fishkeeping 10, breeding and selling Commons makes a small profit (sales beat food, care and eggs on most days)
No Uncommon fish before the shop first opens (day 11), whatever the play style
After opening, an Uncommon turns up by lucky chance in some games (20-80% by day 20)
No more than 2 Uncommons at a time before day 20
A lucky Uncommon can be kept alive (still one alive on day 25 in most games that found one)
No Rare (or rarer) fish before day 30, whatever the play style
Algae is a fight early on (12%+ average) and at least 25% lower by days 20-30
Water quality is hard to keep up early on and at least 5 points better by days 20-30
Commons are easy to keep alive early on (under 1 death per 100 fish-days, days 1-30)
Uncommons give trouble: they die at least 1.5x as often as Commons
Rares die without upgraded tanks (Cautious never upgrades gear): 3+ deaths per 100 fish-days
Rares can be kept with upgraded tanks (Breeder upgrades gear): under 2 deaths per 100 fish-days
